description: Memory Plane envelope — the one plane per integration key.

contribution_store_ref.description: Reference (URI-form) to the plane's contribution store partition. Plane-local; scoped_accessor enforces isolation by construction.
contribution_store_ref.title: Contribution Store Ref

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of plane issuance.
issued_at.title: Issued At

issued_to_integration_key.description: Integration key (or engineer key) this plane is bound to. Immutable.
issued_to_integration_key.title: Issued To Integration Key

retrieval_scope.description: The estate slice the plane may read (feed_id / grain filter / time window). Immutable after issue.
retrieval_scope.title: Retrieval Scope

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of revocation, when applicable.
revoked_at.title: Revoked At

state.description: Plane lifecycle state. Revocation freezes reads immediately (services/memory/revocation.py).
state.title: State

tenant_id.description: Multi-instance scope. Enforced by scoped_accessor at every read.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

working_set_ref.description: Reference to the plane's working set (references, not copies). Grows from observed use per usage-proportional persistence rule.
working_set_ref.title: Working Set Ref

title: MemoryPlane_v0
